DAJ, GEL, JIN, MMP, ?

• First letter ⇒ (3) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter ⇒ (4) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter ⇒ (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36b3cd045a22ce3c9ffd2e75a35d8f668d41469830cf0e2824a1d1650ad7a6c7.png]
